instruction: Help me to install Qogir icon theme from gnome-look.org and set it as my GNOME desktop icon theme.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to install Qogir icon theme from gnome-look.org and apply it using GNOME settings. Evaluator checks if icon-theme setting contains 'Qogir' by executing gsettings command and checking the output. Uses existing framework functions (check_list metric + cache_file getter). Similar complexity to original task - both involve downloading theme from gnome-look.org and applying via GNOME settings, targeting icon theme instead of GTK theme.
metadata.verification: Verified that gsettings 'org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme' is a valid GNOME setting. Qogir is a well-known icon theme available on gnome-look.org. Task is feasible and similar to original - both use gnome-look.org as source.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses gsettings command to check the GNOME icon theme setting after task completion
The postconfig executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme' which is the appropriate command to verify icon theme configuration
Expected value 'Qogir' correctly matches what should appear in gsettings output when the theme is properly set
check_list metric function appropriately searches for the regex pattern 'Qogir' in the gsettings output file
Evaluator verifies the final state (theme being set) which is the critical requirement, even though it doesn't directly verify the installation source (gnome-look.org)
Logic flow is sound: postconfig executes command → cache_file getter reads output → check_list searches for pattern → returns pass/fail
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The evaluator only verifies that the icon theme is set to 'Qogir', not that it was specifically downloaded from gnome-look.org. However, this is acceptable because verifying the download source is impractical and the final state (theme being set) is what truly matters for task success.
